title: Curvature-rank as confinement layer (categorical reading of confinement)
html:
Remark. Curvature-rank as confinement layer (categorical reading of confinement)

Remark (curvature-rank as confinement layer). By confinement-categorical, the collapse of the GB-filtration spectral sequence provides the categorical content of color confinement. Translating this algebraic statement into QCD vocabulary yields the following dictionary.

Confinement layers. The GB filtration J^0 \supset J^1 \supset \cdots stratifies A = H_n(R, q) by curvature-rank k = \mathrm{depth}(\lambda) - 1. Each stratum J^k / J^{k+1} acts as a confinement layer:

  • k = 0 (centre): elements are gauge-invariant. This forms the observable hadron content.
  • k \geq 1: extracting an element requires energy proportional to the curvature 2-cocycle F (the combined Hecke and Yang-Baxter obstruction). This is categorically the string tension.

String tension = curvature 2-cocycle. The Hecke relation T^2 = (q - q^{-1}) T + 1 and Yang-Baxter relations define a 2-cocycle F on the GB filtration. F obstructs the extraction of a non-central element along the filtration. It matches how QCD string tension obstructs the extraction of an isolated colored quark. The QCD "string" corresponds to the chain of commutators [a, b] required to move an element through the layers J^k.

Gluon condensate = chirality channel. The chirality cells D_q^2 = 0 in the q-Dirac cell scanner (\lambda = (2, 1) for H_3 and higher-n analogues) coincide with the S-fixed central elements of A. They produce a persistent gauge-invariant background. This is the categorical analogue of the gluon condensate in QCD. The volume match \mathrm{Vol}(B_3) = 8 G with the gluon octet dimension \dim \mathfrak{su}(3) = 8 provides the operator-side identification.

Hadron mass = sum of confinement layers. The unified mass formula (unified mass formula) reads physical hadron mass as a sum over confinement layers:

  \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}
  \;=\; \sum_{k = 0}^{n - 1} \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(1).

Each layer contributes its q-deformed Wedderburn-weighted log-character content (cf. w_\lambda(q) in prop:plancherel-term-7-formulation).

Stratum Confinement layer Physical content
k = 0 centre / vacuum photon-like / unconfined
k = 1, 2 low-tower specific hyperbolic-knot ideals (named knots)
k = 3 chirality layer D_q^2 = 0, gluon-condensate background
k \geq 4 universal residue Frobenius co-Casimir tail (no specific knot)

Predictive consequence. Confinement is structurally built into the spectral-sequence collapse. Every prediction (universal residue, \mathfrak{Q}_\beta structural derivation) is gauge-invariant because the spectral-sequence projection forces all results through Z(A). The rank-3 chirality residue \mathrm{Vol}(6_1) \cdot |(q;q)_3| in the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta formula acts as a gluon-condensate background term. The rank-\geq 4 universal Pochhammer tail |(q;q)_4| serves as the Frobenius co-Casimir. Both are necessary confinement residues, not free parameters.
